integrity: Theorem stated with its exact graph, randomness, parameter ranges, proof, source comparisons, and reproducible independent exact-state/direct-permutation checks. No independent external validation or authorship claimed. An equivalent result in unindexed literature remains possible.
scientific_limitations: Uniform permutations on the balanced crown graph for integer n>=3 only. Results do not address weighted, asymmetric or blown-up crown graphs, other coloring methods or nonuniform arrival models. Full infinite proof given; tests are finite corroboration.
title: Exact random-order FirstFit color distribution on crown graphs
